dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular and jagged perimeters of high-contrast light pixels forming closed 'O' and semi-closed 'C' patterns; prominent structures on the dorsal surface exhibit sharp transitions from the light ring edge to a dark interior core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, localized high-intensity pixel clusters lacking internal structure, predominantly distributed along the lower flank and posterior region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent dorsal macro-annuli form an obtuse triangle, with the longest side extending from the anterior-dorsal ring to the mid-posterior dorsal ring.
